name: Exp_ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines JJRSX (Jurik Relative Strength Index) with Schaff Trend Cycle logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on downtrend signals, with configurable money management and stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JJRSX（Jurik相对强弱指数）和Schaff趋势周期逻辑。当指标发出上涨信号时开多仓，发出下跌信号时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle指标，该指标融合了JJRSX（Jurik相对强弱指数的平滑变体）与Schaff趋势周期的振荡器逻辑，用于识别市场动量的方向变化。入场条件为：当指标颜色值大于5且前一值小于6时开多仓，当颜色值小于2且前一值大于1时开空仓，本质上是在捕捉趋势周期的转折点。出场条件分为主动出场和被动出场：主动出场根据指标反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），被动出场依赖固定的止损和止盈参数。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金比例或固定手数计算，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，但缺乏基于波动率或ATR的动态仓位调整机制。该策略具有新K线检测机制避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许在指定K线上判断信号以减少延迟。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle indicator, which combines JJRSX (a smoothed variant of the Jurik Relative Strength Index) with Schaff Trend Cycle oscillator logic to identify directional shifts in market momentum. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator color value exceeds 5 and the previous value was below 6, while a sell position opens when the color value drops below 2 and the previous value was above 1, essentially capturing turning points in the trend cycle. Exit conditions include both active and passive exits: active exits close positions based on opposing indicator signals (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags), while passive exits rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters. Position sizing leverages multiple modes from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, including calculation based on free margin, balance, post-loss margin percentage, or fixed lot size, with the default using fixed lot mode (LOT). Money management is controlled by the MM parameter at a default risk ratio of 0.1, but it lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms based on volatility or ATR. The strategy incorporates a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trades and uses the SignalBar parameter to evaluate signals on a specified bar to reduce latency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 风险比例，控制交易仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：按自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许指标反向时平多仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许指标反向时平空仓

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用的价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于判断交易信号的K线索引

pros: 使用Schaff趋势周期与JJRSX双重平滑，信号稳定性较好，能有效过滤市场噪音
提供多种资金管理模式选择，灵活度高，适应不同风险偏好
具有新K线检测机制避免同根K线重复交易，减少不必要的交易成本
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，策略配置灵活
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Uses dual smoothing with Schaff Trend Cycle and JJRSX, providing stable signals that effectively filter market noise
Offers multiple money management modes with high flexibility to accommodate different risk preferences
Incorporates new bar detection to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing unnecessary trading costs
Buy/sell open and close controls can be independently toggled, providing flexible strategy configuration
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle，该指标需单独安装且无法直接验证其内部逻辑
止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点，点数较大可能导致某些品种上风险敞口过高
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大的品种上可能产生不利成交
没有仓位数量限制，在连续信号下可能多次开仓导致过度集中风险
指标阈值（颜色值>5或<2）为硬编码魔数，缺乏可配置性和逻辑透明度
cons_en: Depends on the custom ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle indicator which must be installed separately and its internal logic cannot be directly verified
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large values that may result in excessive risk exposure on certain instruments
Lacks a spread filter mechanism, which may lead to unfavorable fills on instruments with wide spreads
No position count limit, potentially allowing multiple entries on consecutive signals leading to over-concentration risk
Indicator thresholds (color value >5 or <2) are hardcoded magic numbers lacking configurability and logical transparency
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易以避免不利成交
添加最大持仓数量限制，防止单方向过度集中风险
将指标颜色阈值参数化（目前硬编码的5、6、2、1），提高策略可调性和透明度
增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，替代固定点数以适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable fills
Add a maximum position count limit to prevent over-concentration risk in a single direction
Parameterize the indicator color thresholds (currently hardcoded 5, 6, 2, 1) to improve strategy adjustability and transparency
Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit calculation to replace fixed point values for better adaptation to varying market volatility

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或更新不兼容将导致EA无法运行
固定点数止损止盈在不同波动率环境下可能不适用，低波动品种止损过远而高波动品种止损过近
无最大持仓限制，连续同方向信号可能导致过度加仓
risk_points_en: Depends on an external custom indicator; if the indicator file is missing or updated incompatibly, the EA will fail to run
Fixed point stop loss/take profit may be inappropriate across different volatility environments - too far for low-volatility instruments and too close for high-volatility ones
No maximum position limit; consecutive same-direction signals may lead to excessive position accumulation
